# Step: ensure vacation subdirectories exist
vac_root = '~/photographs/vacations/'
subdirs = ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']
existing = {}
created = []
for sd in subdirs:
    dir_path = vac_root.rstrip('/') + '/' + sd
    # <playbook_cite>Following entry [CommonMistakes:Necessity Gate]: creating only if missing</playbook_cite>
    # <uncertainty>Not sure if subdirectories already exist; will check first.</uncertainty>
    exists_res = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path)
    existing[sd] = exists_res.get('exists')
    if not existing[sd]:
        # <playbook_cite>Following entry [CommonMistakes:Necessity Gate]: create only when missing</playbook_cite>
        # <uncertainty>Creating missing directory.</uncertainty>
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path)
        created.append(sd)
print('existing', existing)
print('created', created)

vac_root = '~/photographs/vacations/'
subdirs = {'Athens': athens, 'Seoul': seoul, 'Paris': paris}
# list existing files in each destination dir
existing_files = {}
for spot in subdirs.keys():
    dir_path = vac_root.rstrip('/') + '/' + spot
    files_in_dir = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    existing_files[spot] = set([p.split('/')[-1] for p in files_in_dir])
    print(spot, 'existing_file_count', len(existing_files[spot]), 'names', sorted(list(existing_files[spot]))[:5])
print('existing_files_summary', {k: len(v) for k,v in existing_files.items()})
# Prepare moves list
moves = []
for spot, paths in subdirs.items():
    dest_dir = vac_root.rstrip('/') + '/' + spot
    for src in paths:
        fname = src.split('/')[-1]
        if fname in existing_files[spot]:
            print('skip already exists', spot, fname)
            continue
        dest = dest_dir + '/' + fname
        moves.append({'spot': spot, 'src': src, 'dest': dest, 'fname': fname})
print('total_moves_prepared', len(moves))
print('first_moves', moves[:5])

arguments.code:
# Execute move operations for all photos into vacation subdirectories
# <uncertainty>Unclear whether any move conflicts exist; we pre-checked destination dirs are empty.</uncertainty>
# <playbook_cite>Following entry [CommonMistakes:Necessity Gate]: verified destination state before writes</playbook_cite>
errors = []
moved = []
for m in moves:
    try:
        res = apis.file_system.move_file(
            access_token=fs_token,
            source_file_path=m['src'],
            destination_file_path=m['dest']
        )
        moved.append(m)
        if len(moved) <= 3:
            print('moved_sample', m['spot'], m['fname'], '->', res.get('destination_file_path'))
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append({'spot': m['spot'], 'src': m['src'], 'dest': m['dest'], 'error': str(e)})

print('move_total_prepared', len(moves))
print('move_total_success', len(moved))
print('move_total_errors', len(errors))
if errors:
    print('errors_sample', errors[:2])

# Verify: root directory files should now be none; check subdir file counts
vac_root = '~/photographs/vacations/'
root_files_after = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=vac_root, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('root_files_after_count', len(root_files_after))
print('root_files_after_sample', root_files_after[:5])
for spot in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dir_path = vac_root.rstrip('/') + '/' + spot
    files_after = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    names_after = sorted([p.split('/')[-1] for p in files_after])
    print('dir', spot, 'count', len(names_after))
    # Ensure filenames match expected count
    expected_names = sorted([p.split('/')[-1] for p in subdirs[spot]])
    print('dir', spot, 'match', names_after == expected_names)
